[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# An inactive .go file in a GOROOT logos/* package can import a LoGOs package
# that no active file imports. Eject lowers inactive variants before writing
# the output tree, so that package must join the lowering instead of failing
# the support copy on its missing staged output. The test installs fixture
# packages in a private toolchain root inside $WORK and selects it with
# GOROOT. Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
# A platform-only dependency cannot load on this target: a helper holding
# only a windows-tagged file reports no Go files on linux, and the
# discovery skips it instead of aborting the valid alternate build. The
# support copy still carries its tagged source.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^goimp$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgoleaf/leaf.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestwinhelper/helper_windows.go

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build -mod=readonly ./...
go run .
stdout '^goimp$'
go build -mod=readonly -tags pr270goimp ./...

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestgoimp/base.go --
package ejecttestgoimp

func Name() string { return "goimp" }

-- dep/ejecttestgoimp/extra.go --
//go:build pr270goimp

package ejecttestgoimp

import "logos/ejecttestgoleaf"

func ExtraName() string { return ejecttestgoleaf.Leaf() }

-- dep/ejecttestgoimp/plat_windows.go --
//go:build windows

package ejecttestgoimp

import "logos/ejecttestwinhelper"

func WindowsName() string { return ejecttestwinhelper.Helper() }

-- dep/ejecttestwinhelper/helper_windows.go --
//go:build windows

package ejecttestwinhelper

func Helper() string { return "winhelper" }

-- dep/ejecttestgoleaf/leaf.lgo --
package ejecttestgoleaf

func Leaf() string { return "leaf" }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/goimportdep

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestgoimp"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestgoimp.Name())
}
